# RxLaboratorio

> > French nonprofit developing free and open-source tools for animation, motion design, and film production, including Duik Ángela, Ramses, and specialized plugins for After Effects, Blender, and Maya.

RxLaboratorio is led by Nicolas Dufresne (Duduf) and focuses on creating professional-grade animation tools, technical documentation, and educational resources. The organization promotes free software philosophy while providing production pipeline solutions for the animation industry.

## Key Topics

- Duik Ángela
- After Effects character rigging
- Ramses production tracking
- Open-source animation tools
- Blender Geometry Nodes
- Maya pipeline tools
- Color management workflows
- OCA (Open Cel Animation)
- Motion design
- Free software philosophy
- Film production pipeline
- GNU GPL-v3 licensing
- Digital imaging standards
- Animation interchange formats
- Technical documentation

## Core Tools & Software

- [Duik Ángela: The API Source Code](https://rxlaboratorio.org/books/duik-angela-the-api-source-code): Duik Ángela API source code & open-source manifesto by Duduf
- [Ramses](https://rxlaboratorio.org/rx-tool/ramses): Asset management & production tracking framework for film pipeline
- [OCA](https://rxlaboratorio.org/rx-tool/oca): Open Cel Animation format for frame-by-frame animation interchange
- [DuBlast for Blender](https://rxlaboratorio.org/rx-tool/dublast-for-blender): Blender addon for playblast & viewport animation preview rendering
- [DuPivot](https://rxlaboratorio.org/rx-tool/dupivot): Maya plugin for pivot manipulation, rigging & mesh center tools

## Books & Technical Documentation

- [Books](https://rxlaboratorio.org/books): Collection of technical books on Duik Ángela, color management & OpenEXR
- [Practical Guide to Digital Color Management](https://rxlaboratorio.org/books/practical-guide-to-digital-color-management): Guide to color management for After Effects, Blender & Maya workflows
- [Duik Ángela: The API Source Code (Product)](https://rxlaboratorio.org/product/duik-api-source-code): Product page for Duik Ángela API source code & After Effects rigging
- [Le trou noir philosophique](https://rxlaboratorio.org/product/le-trou-noir-philosophique): French book on AI philosophy & critical analysis of generative AI

## Tutorials & Learning Resources

- [MoTools: Using the MoGrapher](https://rxlaboratorio.org/rx-tutorial/motools-using-the-mographer): Tutorial on MoGrapher for Blender geometry nodes & motion design
- [Tutorials – Annual Subscription](https://rxlaboratorio.org/product/tutorials-annual-subscription): Annual subscription for Duik Ángela animation tutorials & courses
